definitions.definition: The reins of the chariot; in Kaṭha 1.3.3 the mind (manas) is said to be the reins, and the one who holds them is the man who reaches the goal (1.3.9).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

definitions.definition: The charioteer of the chariot; the intellect (buddhi, 1.3.3) or discriminating understanding (vijñāna, 1.3.9).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

definitions.definition: The self joined with body, senses and mind, called the enjoyer by the wise (1.3.4).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

definitions.definition: The chariot of the simile: the body (śarīra), 1.3.3.
